curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Jacques possesses a body that adapts to deep water like a marine mammal, but chasing that profound underwater threshold carries the same danger that claimed his father.
curatedMovie.description: Childhood friends Jacques and Enzo bond over the peril of free diving. Following the sea death of his father, Jacques discovers his heart rate and breathing can shift underwater to mirror the biology of dolphins.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Deliberate, heavy, and deeply emotional, this lengthy oceanic drama asks for focused attention on date night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Luc Besson's expansive romantic drama takes its time, offering an adventurous look at mortal limits, aquatic obsession, and the profound physical pull of the open ocean.
